entities.name: EAP message reliable transport procedure
entities.description: Provides reliable transport of EAP-request message, ngKSI, and ABBA from network to UE, and EAP-response message from UE to network.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message
entities.description: Message that initiates the EAP message reliable transport procedure.

entities.name: EAP message IE
entities.description: Information Element contained in the AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message for EAP transport.

entities.name: ngKSI
entities.description: Key Set Identifier for next generation networks, transported from network to UE.

entities.name: ABBA
entities.description: Anti-Bidding down Between Architectures parameter, transported from network to UE.

entities.name: EAP-request message
entities.description: EAP message transported from network to UE.

entities.name: EAP-response message
entities.description: EAP message transported from UE to network.
